title: Good for free. Very basic.
body:
No month view, can only see the active week so hard to review progress. Literally have to skip back one day at a time. 

No date filter to check progress between dates and no search so you cannot go back and review or change previous days without, again, skipping back a single day at a time. 

Would be useful to be able to choose a task and get completion statistics filterable by week, month, year and selectable time frames. 

Again, decent for free.
author: Jamzzzzzzs

title: Avoid this app - appears to be a scam now
body:
You may notice I posted a review in April to say this app was now charging for features that were previously free.
I paid the annual fee as I had 3 years worth of history I didn’t want to lose.
It’s now trying to charge again even though I have a subscription for another 7 months.
Appears to be a scam now. Avoid this app

title: Крутое приложение
body:
Круто, что можно написать привычки которые ты хочешь сформировать и отслеживать их выполнение в течение дня. Нравится, что на каждую привычку можно поставить отдельное уведомление. 
Еще понравилась «фича» со значками достижений - мотивирует заходить и отмечать привычки.

Огромный плюс приложения в том, что все функции бесплатны.
